text:
```yaml
name: Build Android Port

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up JDK 8
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '8'
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

    - name: Setup workspace
      run: |
        chmod +x scripts/setup-workspace.sh
        ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests -DskipArchetypeTests=true

    - name: Build Android Port
      run: |
        source tools/env.sh
        ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true

    - name: Validate YAML files
      run: |
        curl -sSL https://github.com/adrienverge/yamllint/releases/download/v1.32.0/yamllint-1.32.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | tar xz
        ./yamllint .github/workflows/scripts-android.yml
        ./yamllint .github/workflows/scripts-ios.yml
```
